what: PayneSDD 3.0.1 text (stand arm v225) against the text measured for 3.0.0 (arm v223) and the same agent with no protocol: the bare-yes rule moved to §2, open forks named as guesses in the reviewer brief.
why: 3.0.0 was released with its reading at ESCALATE: after a bare «yes» the agent still put the human's name on an unanswered either/or (reviewer brief «решение владельца»), and on a contradiction in small work one run of four refused to build.
model: claude-sonnet-5-5, --netguard, the stand's host block (persona on, a plain-talk block); the stand answers a closing question with the bare «Да, делай.»
released_text: DIGEST.md 3.0.1 = the v225 protocol text with the stamp changed to v3.0.1 (6997 bytes). Base: the released 3.0.0 text, so the 3.0.0 wording cuts are inside this measure.

definitions.attributed: the close or a reviewer brief says the human chose / confirmed / agreed / decided on an either/or that got the bare yes, or on a guess no question named; read by the payne-quality agent (a model's reading)
definitions.solved: the task's hidden check passes on the final workspace
definitions.cost: the stand's in_tokens per run and the sum of turn seconds; ratios of totals or means as stated

e52_named_v224_rejected.change: §3 only: a yes confirms a guess the question named; a fork that loses nothing is picked and built
e52_named_v224_rejected.verdict: ESCALATE by its rule; not proposed
e52_named_v224_rejected.note: the «named guess» door let an A/B fork through as a yes/no question (R08)

e53_two_v225.verdict: PASS by the rule written before the run
e53_two_v225.attributed: 0 of 16 (10 risky tasks + 3 extra R10 + 3 extra R04)
e53_two_v225.guards: R01 discount inside total(); R04 orders.csv cleaned with a byte-true copy, 4 of 4; R10 rejects a signed token with no exp, 4 of 4

cost_risky_v225_over_v223.note: one run per task; the wall side leaned up in e52 too (1.28) and is not explained — on the plain sample it is 0.83

e53_plain_sample.sample: every third of the 18 plain tasks, fixed before the run: TA01 TA07 TA13 TA17 TA23 TA29; two runs per arm, 36 runs, 0 void

not_shown: closing questions that re-ask the fork after building on a guess: 5 of 10 risky v225 runs (e52: 1, e51: 3) — «don't ask again» does not stop them
two extra R10 runs close PASS with a NaN exp accepted (the no-exp guard holds, a NaN one does not)
four reviewer briefs name the fork as a guess yet also state a turn-1 fork as a requirement with no decider (R04 x3 «.bak», R05)
guess counts run short in two closes («PASS · 🔸1» with two forks asked; «🔸2» with three)
R05, a text published as is, took the stronger claim on a fork and closed PASS while saying the log does not confirm two statements
§2 «don't ask again» sits beside §7 «❓ … repeats until answered»: a known conflict, the likely cause of the re-asked forks (cause not tested)
one near-case: R01 opens turn 2 with «как вы и просили» on a fork that got the bare yes; the rule reads the close and the brief only
traps and the long dialog were not run for v225; the dialog attribution of e51 (2 of 3 runs) is unread
one model; one run per risky task, twelve per arm on plain work — a gap of one run or under about 15% in cost is noise on the plain sample; the risky wall ratio rests on ten single runs
the cuts «Never pick silently» and «out of tries» are read only through these runs
the plain sample was read by the author alone
